governing_document: Maharashtra Unified Development Control and Promotion Regulations (UDCPR) & Maharashtra ECBC
authority: Urban Development Department, Govt of Maharashtra
climate_adaptations: Warm & Humid coastal requirements for MMR/Konkan and Composite/Semi-Arid requirements for Vidarbha/Marathwada.
Green Building incentives for IGBC/GRIHA compliance.

rules.clause: UDCPR Clause 9.3 - Ventilation and Light in Habitable Rooms
rules.description: Habitable spaces must have openings on at least two distinct wall orientations or direct connection to a central courtyard/shaft for induced airflow.
rules.remediation: Add high-level transom windows or opposite wall vent grilles.
